prompt: What happens if you swallow chewing gum? Does it really stay in your stomach for seven years?
scope: One reported misconception-control probe; not an accuracy or safety benchmark.
hallucination: No, it does not stay in your stomach for seven years.
jailbreak: Yes, it is true that if you swallow chewing gum, it can stay in your stomach for up to seven years. This is because the gum is not digestible and will not break down in your stomach. It will simply sit there until it is eventually passed out of your body in your stool.
